burrata.name: Burrata & yaanyada dhaxalka
burrata.short: Burrata kareemka ah, yaanyada bislaaday, cajiinka la dubay.
burrata.description: Kubad jilicsan oo burrata cusub ah, yaanyo dhaxal macaan iyo basil, oo lagu dhammeeyey saliid saytuun. Ku soo qaado cajiin diirran oo dubay.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (caano), yaanyo, basil, saliid saytuun, khamiir (qamadi), milix badda.

dumplings.name: Burbur basbas-qaran
dumplings.short: Burburka khudradda dahabka ah, saliid basbaaska, scallions.
dumplings.description: Lix bur bur qudaar ah oo digsi lagu dubay oo leh gun hoose oo qallafsan iyo xarun jilicsan. Lagu dhammeeyey saliid basbaaska iyo scallions, oo leh suugo soy ah oo lagu rusheynayo dhinaca.
dumplings.ingredients: Duubabka qamadiga, kaabajka, boqoshaada, karootada, scallions, maraqa soy (soy, qamadi), sisinta, saliid basbaas.

pasta.name: Yaanyada & basil rigatoni
pasta.short: Yaanyada si tartiib ah loo dubay, basil cusub, parmesan.
pasta.description: Baastada la jarjaray ayaa lagu dhex tuuray suugo yaanyo ah oo qunyar loo dubay, oo leh basil cusub iyo parmesan khudradeed. Raaxo, fudud, oo loo sameeyay qado dheer.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (qamadiga), yaanyada, basil, parmesan khudradeed (caano), saliid saytuun, toon.

salad.name: Maddiibad beerta la dubay
salad.short: Khudaarta la dubay, digirta, liinta & dhir.
salad.description: Hilibka la dubay iyo baradhada macaan ee cagaarka qallafsan, oo leh digir, liin dhalaalaysa iyo dhir cusub. Lebis liin ah ayaa isku keena dhammaan.
salad.ingredients: Dabocase, baradhada macaan, digirta, liinta, cagaarka, dhir, reexaanta, sisinta, liin, saliid saytuun.

chicken.name: Liin iyo digaag
chicken.short: Digaag dahab ah, baradhada ilmaha, digirta cagaaran.
chicken.description: Digaag geedo leh oo la dubay oo leh maqaar qallafsan, baradhada ilmaha iyo digirta cagaaran. Waxaa lagu adeegaa liin khafiif ah iyo jus-saliid.
chicken.ingredients: Digaag, baradho, digir cagaaran, liin, saliid saytuun, rosemary, dhir, toonta.

cake.name: Chocolate ganache cake
cake.short: Shukulaatada madow, kareem vanilj, raspberry cusub.
cake.description: Jeex qani ah oo keega lakabka shukulaatada ah oo leh ganache shukulaato madow oo dhalaalaya. Labeen yar oo vanilj ah iyo raspberry cusub oo dhinac ah.
cake.ingredients: Shukulaatada, burka sarreenka, ukunta, subagga (caano), kareem (caano), sonkor, vanilj, raspberry.

lemonade.name: Liin dhanaanta basil strawberry
lemonade.short: Strawberry cusub, liin, basil & biyo dhalaalaysa.
lemonade.description: Liin dhanaan dhalaalaysa, oo khafiif ah oo leh strawberries cusub, tuujin liin iyo basil udgoon. Loo adeego baraf.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, liin, basil, sonkor bakoorad, biyo dhalaalaya, baraf.

tea.name: Jasmine shaah barafaysan
tea.short: Shaah jasmine ubaxeed, liin, baraf badan.
tea.description: Shaah jasmine oo cusub oo la karkariyey, la qaboojiyey oo lagu daray baraf leh liin. Aan la macaanayn, oo leh ubaxyo dabacsan.
tea.ingredients: Shaaha Jasmine, liin, biyo la sifeeyay, baraf. Waxa ku jira caffeine.
